args.body: Use static-index-evidence.json if committed and compare its pointers with the original index. Count the earlier 404 and the committed HTTP 200 toward the three-attempt allowance. Spend the final GET on a concrete original challenge link if one looks relevant. If the index is only a client-rendered shell, use the final GET on an official active-challenge endpoint only if the source establishes one. If a live non-security brief gives an explicit prize and a measurable requirement, execute passing and failing fictional controls and preserve actual outputs even if submission or payout remains unresolved. Otherwise record exactly what the captures covered and reopen on an original live brief with a relevant scoring rule. Read back the evidence and close under a valid lease with a lesson. Preserve independent review for any public release.
